node.title: All-admissible-row F2 extras-budget close
node.statement: ROUND-17 REPAIR: prove directly that non-coset-union F2 extras plus trade families are at most n^3=2^123 on every official prize-max admissible row. The July conditional close on growing-order Myerson is not valid at this scope: the 16-rung tower is inadmissible, there are at most two moving rungs, and (O1) is false whenever ord_n(p)<[F_q:F_p]. The proved empty/edge bands, dictionary, contraction, near-tail, structural census, and admissible direct-sum reduction remain available. The honest attack surface is: generating-row prime-field GRS ternary mass; a direct replacement payment on non-generating rows; the PP5.0 average-to-sum seam; and any coset-sensitive use of Frobenius antipodal descent. No consumer status is promoted by this repair.
